A '''Sith holocron''' was hidden by [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith acolytes]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kruskan]] [[3000 BBY|three thousand years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The servants of local [[Noble/Legends|noblewoman]] [[Regera Girawn]] later found the [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifact]] and brought it to their mistress. As Girawn handled the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], the artifact exploded in a burst of [[Color/Legends|purplish]] light that scarred the [[Gender/Legends|woman's]] face and [[Limb/Legends|hands]], while also awakening her [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]]. The abilities granted her [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] that drove her insane and led her to travel [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] disciples.

==Description==
The [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] hidden on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kruskan]] was shaped like a pulsing sphere. Upon contact with the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Regera Girawn]], the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] exploded in a burst of [[Color/Legends|purplish]] light that activated Girawn's [[The Force/Legends|Force]] potential, giving her [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of the [[Time/Legends|past]], present, and future. The blast also left both her mind and face scarred and warped.<ref name="RGFW" />

==History==
[[File:Regera_Girawn.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Rigera Girawn was scarred when the holocron exploded in her hands.]]
[[3000 BBY|Three thousand years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith acolytes]] traveled to the backwater planet Kruskan in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and hid a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] holocron in a [[Unidentified Sith ruins|mountain stronghold]] not far from what eventually became the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="RGFW" />

Sometime later, the servants of a local [[Noble/Legends|noblewoman]], Regera Girawn, discovered the holocron while unearthing the ruins in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]]. Taking the holocron to [[Regera Girawn's palace|Girawn's palace]], the servants presented the [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifact]] to their [[Gender/Legends|mistress]]. When Girawn handled the holocron, it released a blast of light that destroyed the holocron and left the noblewoman's [[Limb/Legends|hands]] and face burned. The power of the artifact triggered Girawn's Force potential and granted her visions in which she saw herself leading an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] disciples.<ref name="RGFW" />

The power and visions Girawn gained from the holocron drove her insane, and her subjects soon deposed her. Using her recently acquired [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], Girawn fled her planet and, attempting to heed her visions, roamed [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search of Force-sensitives to become her disciples.<ref name="RGFW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith holocron was first mentioned in the [[Wizards.com]] article "[[Bounty Postings|Regera Girawn, Force Witch]]," a supplement for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook [[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]. It was written by [[Eric Cagle]] and posted on [[December 9]], [[2008]].<ref name="RGFW" />
